parsed.draft_response:
Sorry about the disruption—this sounds urgent, and I understand you’re running out of time. We can help, but I’ll need a few details to pinpoint what’s failing since “nothing works” and “same as last time” don’t specify which workflow.

Please reply with the minimum info below:
1) What exact feature/workflow doesn’t work (e.g., login, specific page/action, sync, import/export)?
2) Any error message shown (exact text), or a screenshot.
3) When it started and whether it’s consistent or intermittent.
4) Your environment: OS/browser (or app version), and whether this is one tenant/account or multiple users.

If you can’t gather all of that right now, tell me just #1 (which workflow) and #2 (any error text/screenshot), and we’ll take it from there.

We’ve escalated this for investigation based on your report, and once we have the above details we’ll move faster toward identifying the cause and next steps.
promised_actions: Use the details you provide to identify the failing workflow and determine next steps
safety_notes: No specific fix or refund promised due to missing reproduction/error details.
